analysis.session_summary: The Friday close through Asia reopen lacked high-impact data, leaving flows to dominate. AUD led with +0.262% and CAD followed at +0.241%, while JPY lagged at -0.314%; USD was soft with DXY -0.065%. VIX rose +4.335% to 18.47692 and Brent gained +3.874%, supporting commodity FX. The only measured event, BOE Gov Bailey, printed a 0.000% basket impulse inside the noise floor.

themes.evidence: AUD +0.262% and CAD +0.241% led; Brent rose +3.874%.
JPY was weakest at -0.314%; CHF/JPY rose 92.3 pips and USD/JPY rose 26.7 pips.
All legs show cause null/confidence none; BOE Bailey reaction was 0.000% inside the noise floor.

scenarios.name: CAD CPI in line extends CAD strength
scenarios.thesis: Headline CPI at 0.2% m/m with core metrics stable leaves CAD's recent strength intact.
triggers: CAD CPI m/m prints at or below 0.2%

pair_paths.rationale: USD/CAD already fell 54.5 pips; in-line CPI can sustain the move.

scenarios.name: Risk-on extends JPY weakness
scenarios.thesis: AUD and Brent strength continue, pressuring JPY further.

pair_paths.rationale: USD/JPY range was 64.1 pips; risk-on flows can push toward the top of that range.

scenarios.name: Event-light consolidation
scenarios.thesis: No high-impact data until CAD CPI, so major pairs hold recent ranges.
triggers: CAD CPI prints near 0.2% without surprise

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/USD traded a 88.5-pip range; without a catalyst it can stay within that band.

risks.risk: VIX rose +4.335% to 18.47692 while commodity FX outperformed.
risks.why_it_matters: If volatility keeps rising, high-beta gains can unwind quickly.

risks.risk: Most major legs had no clear catalyst.
risks.why_it_matters: Unexplained moves can reverse quickly when real news hits.
risks.watch: CAD CPI and any BOJ Ueda follow-up.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: CAD CPI at 14:30 (forecast 0.2% m/m, previous -0.1%) is the key event; median/trimmed at 2.0/1.9 and common at 2.6 will shape CAD and broader USD sentiment.
